data.name: Lumen Trace
data.detailed_description:
Let’s go find the light together.

Game Overview

Lumen Track is a simple puzzle game. Follow the guidance, restore the shattered fragments of light to their original form, and let the world be filled with light once more.

Legend says that the world was once bathed in radiance.

But one day, that light suddenly shattered into countless pieces and scattered to the ends of the world. In a world without light, colors slowly faded, laughter was carried away by the wind into the far distance, and only incomplete outlines remained.

Following the guidance, you set out on your journey. Each time you find a fragment, a torn image appears before your eyes: a memory, a fleeting moment, an unspoken farewell. Gently, you piece them back together, aligning the cracks and returning each missing part to its rightful place. As the final fragment of light returns where it belongs, the image no longer lies still. Streams of living light begin to spread softly along its lines, and the heartbeat of the world is heard once again.

As each story is restored, you finally come to understand: what you have reclaimed is not only those shattered scenes, but also the courage that lights the way forward. Take one more step.

Bring the light back, and let the world shine once again.

Game Features

  • Over 50 CGs to discover

  • Full animation for every CG

  • A classic puzzle game experience

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS / Ubuntu 20.04 / equivalent 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible integrated or dedicated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS / Ubuntu 22.04 / equivalent 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
